lines.text: I'm bummed out about the trip.

data.define: Used when something small has let you down.

example.text: I'm bummed out about the trip.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bummed out' about serious loss.
misuse.why: It's too light for deep grief.

data.l1_hook: 旅行取消了，大家都很 "bummed out"。
data.l1_ex: 我对这次旅行感到 "bummed out"。
